# Sakuya Cheat Menu Pro - B7 form country helper effects
# Generated from current tag selector plus Victoria 3 country_definitions/cultures evidence.

sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_abk_effect = {
	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:north_caucasian
	set_state_religion = rel:sunni
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_abk_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:ABK } }
		change_tag = ABK
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_abk_effect = yes
	}
} 

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_abk_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:ABK } }
		change_tag = ABK
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_abk_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:ABK }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ABK
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ABK }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:ABK
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_abk_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:ABK }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ABK
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ABK }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:ABK
			}
		}
	}
}

			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = AGC

		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:ALA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ALA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ALA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:ALA
			}
		}
	}
}

			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:ANH }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ANH
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ANH }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:ANH
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:ANK } }
		change_tag = ANK
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_ank_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:ANK }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ANK
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ANK }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:ANK
			}
		}
	}
}

			NOT = { exists = c:BAS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BAS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BAS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:BAS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_bas_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_bgm_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:BGM }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BGM
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BGM }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:BGM
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_bgm_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:BGM }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BGM
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope

		}

			}
		}
	}

			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:BIC }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BIC
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BIC }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:BIC
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_bih_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:BIH }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BIH
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BIH }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:BIH
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_bri_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:BRI } }
		change_tag = BRI
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_bri_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:BRI }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BRI
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BRI }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:BRI
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_bri_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:BRI }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BRI
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BRI }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:BRI
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:BTN } }
		change_tag = BTN
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_btn_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:BTN }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BTN
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:BTN }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:BTN
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_btn_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:BTN }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = BTN
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {

				set_state_owner = c:BTN

			position = 0

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = CAM
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state

			limit = { exists = c:CAM }

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:COC }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = COC
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:COC }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:COC
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_col_effect = {
	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:british
	set_state_religion = rel:protestant
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_col_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:COL } }
		change_tag = COL
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_col_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_col_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:COL } }
		change_tag = COL
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_col_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:COL }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = COL
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:COL }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:COL
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_col_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:COL }

		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_cro_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:CRO }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = CRO
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope

		}

		}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_dnk_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:DNK } }
		change_tag = DNK
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_dnk_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:DNK }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = DNK
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:DNK }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:DNK
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_dnk_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:DNK }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = DNK
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:DNK }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:DNK
			}
		}
	}
}

	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:central_american
	set_state_religion = rel:catholic
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_els_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:ELS } }
		change_tag = ELS
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_els_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_els_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:ELS } }
		change_tag = ELS
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_els_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:ELS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ELS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ELS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:ELS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_els_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:ELS }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ELS
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ELS }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:ELS
			}
		}
	}
}

			position = 0

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = FER
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state

			limit = { exists = c:FER }

		}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_frs_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:FRS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = FRS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:FRS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:FRS
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:GUJ } }
		change_tag = GUJ
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_guj_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:GUJ }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = GUJ
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:GUJ }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:GUJ
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_guj_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:GUJ }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = GUJ
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:GUJ }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:GUJ
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_gwa_effect = {
	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:marathi
	add_primary_culture = cu:bundeli
	set_state_religion = rel:hindu
}

		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:HBC } }
		change_tag = HBC
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_hbc_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:HBC }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = HBC
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:HBC }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:HBC
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_hbc_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:HBC }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = HBC
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:HBC }

				set_state_owner = c:HBC
			}
		}
	}

	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:HTH }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = HTH
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:HTH }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:HTH
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_hun_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:HUN }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = HUN
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:HUN }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:HUN
			}
		}
	}
}

			position = 0

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = IDN
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:IDN }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:IDN
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_jas_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:JAS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = JAS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:JAS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:JAS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_jas_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:JAS }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }

			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = JUN

			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KAZ }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:KAZ
			}
		}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_kba_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:KBA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KBA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KBA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:KBA
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_khr_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:KHR }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KHR
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KHR }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:KHR
			}
		}
	}

			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KKI
			origin = root

			NOT = { exists = c:KPR }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KPR
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KPR }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:KPR
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_kss_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:KSS } }
		change_tag = KSS
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_kss_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:KSS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KSS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KSS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:KSS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_kss_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:KSS }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = KSS
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:KSS }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:KSS
			}
		}
	}
}

			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:LKT }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = LKT
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:LKT }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:LKT
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_lmw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:LMW }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = LMW
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:LMW }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:LMW
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:MAL }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = MAL
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:MAL }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:MAL
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_mal_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:MAL }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = MAL
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:MAL }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:MAL
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:MDK }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = MDK
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:MDK }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:MDK
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = MHR
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:MHR }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:MHR
			}
		}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_mra_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:MRA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = MRA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:MRA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:MRA
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:NAV }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NAV
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:NAV }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:NAV
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_nav_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:NAV }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NAV
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:NAV }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:NAV
			}
		}
	}
}

		change_tag = NET
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_net_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_net_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:NET } }
		change_tag = NET
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_net_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:NET }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NET
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:NET }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:NET
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_net_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:NET }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NET
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:NET }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:NET
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_npu_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:NPU }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NPU
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:NPU }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:NPU
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_npu_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:NPU }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = NPU

		create_country = {

			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }

			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }

		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ORN
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_oua_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:OUA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = OUA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:OUA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:OUA
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_pnm_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:PNM } }
		change_tag = PNM
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_pnm_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:PNM }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = PNM
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:PNM }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:PNM
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_pnm_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:PNM }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = PNM
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:PNM }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:PNM
			}
		}
	}
}

	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:platinean
	add_primary_culture = cu:guarani
	set_state_religion = rel:catholic
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_prg_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:PRG } }
		change_tag = PRG
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_prg_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_prg_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:PRG } }
		change_tag = PRG
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_prg_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:PRG }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = PRG
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:PRG }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:PRG
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_prg_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:PRG }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = PRG
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:PRG }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:PRG
			}
		}
	}
}

			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ROM
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ROM }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:ROM
			}
		}
	}

		limit = {

			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = RSM
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:RSM }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:RSM
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:SAR }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SAR
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SAR }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:SAR
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_sas_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:SAS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SAS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SAS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:SAS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_sia_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:SIA } }
		change_tag = SIA
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_sia_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:SIA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SIA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SIA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:SIA
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_sia_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:SIA }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SIA
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SIA }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:SIA
			}
		}
	}
}

		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:oromo
	set_state_religion = rel:animist
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_sky_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:SKY } }
		change_tag = SKY
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_sky_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_sky_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:SKY } }
		change_tag = SKY
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_sky_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:SKY }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SKY
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SKY }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:SKY
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_sky_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:SKY }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SKY
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:SKY }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:SKY
			}
		}
	}
}

			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {

			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }

			}
		}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_swt_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:SWT }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = SWT
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_trc_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:TRC }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = TRC
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:TRC }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:TRC
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_trc_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {

			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:TRC }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:TSW }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = TSW
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:TSW }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:TSW
			}
		}
	}
}

			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {

				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_uca_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:UCA }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = UCA
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:UCA }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:UCA
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_uom_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:UOM }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = UOM
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:UOM }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:UOM
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_url_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:URL }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = URL
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:URL }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:URL
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:WLS }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = WLS
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:WLS }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:WLS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_wls_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:WLS }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = WLS
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:WLS }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:WLS
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_wlt_effect = {
	every_primary_culture = {
		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:sidama
	set_state_religion = rel:oriental_orthodox
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_wlt_follow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:WLT } }
		change_tag = WLT
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_wlt_effect = yes
	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:XHO } }
		change_tag = XHO
		sakuya_b7_form_country_apply_identity_xho_effect = yes
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_change_tag_xho_raw_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = c:XHO } }
		change_tag = XHO
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_xho_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:XHO }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = XHO
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:XHO }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:XHO
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b7_form_country_marked_release_xho_effect = {
	sakuya_b7_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			NOT = { exists = c:XHO }
			any_state = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = XHO
			origin = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:XHO }
			every_state = {
				limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target owner = scope:sakuya_b7_marked_country_scope }
				set_state_owner = c:XHO
			}
		}
	}
}

		prev = { remove_primary_culture = prev }
	}
	add_primary_culture = cu:han

sakuya_b7_form_country_release_yue_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:YUE }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = YUE
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:YUE }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:YUE
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = c:ZIM }
			any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ZIM
			origin = root
			state = scope:sakuya_b7_form_country_first_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = c:ZIM }
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
				set_state_owner = c:ZIM
			}
		}
	}
}
